**Back up first.** Before you install this version, make a backup in Settings › Backup & data. This version changes how backups work.

**One backup password**
- Set it once in Backup & data and keep it until you change it. Every backup is encrypted with it. Tap "Generate a strong password" if you want one made for you, and save it in your password manager: if you lose this phone, it's the only way to open your backups.
- Seeing, copying, changing or removing it asks for your phone's unlock.
- Changing it re-encrypts the backups in your backup folder. Copies you saved elsewhere keep the old password.
- If automatic backup already had a password, that password is now your backup password. If it had none, automatic backup pauses until you set one.

**Backups carry everything**
- Your log, foods, settings, meal photos, your AI services and their keys, and the USDA key. Restoring on a new phone brings it all back with only the backup password.
- After you restore an encrypted backup, Forkcast offers to keep its password as this phone's backup password.
- Back up now saves to your backup folder, or asks where if you haven't chosen one. Back up and share hands the file to any app (email, cloud storage, messages).
- Back up without encryption makes a copy anyone can read. It says what's inside and asks for your phone's unlock first.

**Automatic backup**
- Pick the days (S M T W T F S) and a time.
- Choose how many old backups to keep: Simple (the last 5), Balanced (the last 7 and one for each of the last 6 months), Long-term (the last 14, one a month for a year and one a year), or your own numbers. Old backups are deleted only after the new one reads back correctly, and only Forkcast backups in that folder.
- Backup files now start with the date and time, for example `2026-10-29_0300_forkcast-backup.forkcast`.

**Meal report**
- Backup & data › Meal report makes a file to share with a doctor or dietitian: the meals of the days you pick, with times, amounts, calories and macros, and each day's totals against your targets. Weight and water are optional. No photos.
- As a PDF to print, or as a spreadsheet with an Items sheet and a Daily totals sheet.
- It replaces the CSV exports under Advanced.

**Smaller changes**
- Export settings is gone, because backups now carry your settings and keys. Settings files you saved before still import, under Advanced.
- Backups now use a stronger way of turning your password into a key (Argon2id). Backups from earlier versions still open.
